note: Face references for the cast; plate as the style reference.
style: A seventeenth-century French narrative oil painting in the manner of Meissonier and Maurice Leloir: academic realism, exact costume of 1625 (doublets, falling lace collars, wide-brimmed plumed felt hats, bucket-top boots, rapiers and baldrics), warm candlelight and golden daylight against blue Paris dusk, rich glazes, fine brushwork. One single painting filling the whole frame edge to edge; no text, lettering, signature, monogram, border or black bars.

beats.text: A head-and-shoulders portrait of D'Artagnan, a Gascon youth of eighteen: a long brown face, high cheekbones, open intelligent eyes, a finely chiselled hooked nose, dark hair to the shoulders, the faint first down of a moustache and no beard; a faded blue woollen doublet, a Béarnais cap with a feather, a long rapier on a leather baldric. Plain dark brown background, soft window light from the left, painted as a study for a history painting.

A head-and-shoulders portrait of the man of Meung (the Comte de Rochefort): a gentleman of forty to forty-five, black piercing eyes, a pale complexion, a strongly marked nose, a black well-shaped moustache, a small pale scar on the temple; a violet doublet with lace collar. Plain dark brown background, soft window light from the left, painted as a study for a history painting.

A head-and-shoulders portrait of Milady de Winter, a woman of twenty-two: pale and fair, long blonde curls falling over her shoulders, large languishing blue eyes, rosy lips, alabaster hands; a dark travelling gown with a lace collar. Plain dark brown background, soft window light from the left, painted as a study for a history painting.

A head-and-shoulders portrait of Athos, a musketeer of about thirty: a noble, handsome, pale melancholy face, dark hair, a small dark moustache, grave dark eyes; the blue musketeer's cassock with the silver cross over a plain doublet. Plain dark brown background, soft window light from the left, painted as a study for a history painting.

A head-and-shoulders portrait of Porthos, a musketeer of giant stature, about thirty: a ruddy laughing face, a magnificent curled brown moustache and small tuft beard, a gold-embroidered baldric and a crimson velvet cloak over the musketeer's blue cassock. Plain dark brown background, soft window light from the left, painted as a study for a history painting.

A head-and-shoulders portrait of Aramis, a young musketeer of twenty-two: a delicate sweet face, soft black eyes, rosy cheeks, a small neat black moustache, white hands; the musketeer's blue cassock with the silver cross, a little clerical in manner. Plain dark brown background, soft window light from the left, painted as a study for a history painting.

A head-and-shoulders portrait of Cardinal Richelieu at forty: a thin pale aristocratic face, a pointed grey-brown beard and moustache, piercing eyes; scarlet cardinal's robes, a red skullcap, a white lace collar. Plain dark brown background, soft window light from the left, painted as a study for a history painting.

A head-and-shoulders portrait of Constance Bonacieux, a young woman of twenty-five: dark hair, blue eyes, a slightly turned-up nose, a fresh pink complexion; a modest dark bodice with a white linen collar. Plain dark brown background, soft window light from the left, painted as a study for a history painting.

A head-and-shoulders portrait of M. de Tréville, captain of the King's Musketeers, about fifty: a hard weathered Gascon face, a grizzled moustache and small beard, keen eyes; a rich dark doublet with the musketeer's cassock and a gold chain. Plain dark brown background, soft window light from the left, painted as a study for a history painting.
